starter:
-- BLACKFRIDAY25 used outside November 2025, web or app, not cancelled
SELECT order_id, order_date, channel
FROM orders
WHERE coupon_code = 'BLACKFRIDAY25'
  AND channel = 'web' OR channel = 'mobile_app'
  AND status <> 'cancelled'
  AND order_date >= '2025-01-01'
  AND order_date < '2025-11-01' OR order_date >= '2025-12-01'
ORDER BY order_date;
solution:
SELECT order_id, order_date, channel
FROM orders
WHERE coupon_code = 'BLACKFRIDAY25'
  AND channel IN ('web', 'mobile_app')
  AND status <> 'cancelled'
  AND order_date >= '2025-01-01'
  AND (order_date < '2025-11-01' OR order_date >= '2025-12-01')
ORDER BY order_date, order_id;
